name: Shin Nippon Biomedical Laboratories
summary: Shin Nippon Biomedical Laboratories, Ltd. operates as a global contract research organization (CRO), delivering comprehensive drug discovery and development services both in Japan and internationally. Its preclinical offerings encompass a wide array of laboratory services, including regulatory-compliant good laboratory practice (GLP) inspections. These studies cover general and specialized toxicity assessments, detailed pathological examinations, pharmacokinetic (PK) and pharmacodynamic (PD) analysis for biopharmaceuticals, immunotoxicity testing, and antibody production. The company also conducts investigations into reproductive and developmental toxicity, pharmacological mechanisms, and efficacy, alongside providing various imaging services. Furthermore, the organization specializes in developing and validating analytical methodologies, analyzing biological specimens, and determining pharmacokinetic parameters. It also conducts studies on absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion (ADME), often utilizing radioisotope-labeled compounds. Beyond preclinical and analytical work, it extends its expertise to clinical trial support through site management organization (SMO) services and broader clinical contract research organization (CRO) support. Its translational research division focuses on advancing novel medical solutions, such as the development of nasal drug delivery systems, nucleic acid-based adjuvants, and regenerative medicine therapies. Established in 1957, Shin Nippon Biomedical Laboratories, Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
